comprehensive_description.scene_content_description: A russet fox walks along a packed snow trail through a stand of tall pine trees at first light. Fresh powder clings to its fur and to the lower branches. The trail is narrow, with blue-shadowed drifts on either side and a pale gold sky visible between the trunks. The fox moves toward the camera with a steady, unhurried gait, pausing once to sniff the air before continuing.
comprehensive_description.camera_movement_description: The camera tracks beside the fox at roughly waist height, holding a medium-wide framing. A slow dolly keeps pace with the animal so it stays centered. Depth of field is moderate: the fox remains sharp while distant trunks fall slightly out of focus.
